_classes.name: stated period stored as on_effective_date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind == 'on_effective_date' and re.search(r'\b(no later than|not later than|within|over a period of)\b[^.;]{0,40}?\b(\d+|one|two|...|one hundred eighty)\b[^.;]{0,10}?\b(days?|months?|years?)\b', quote, re.I) (misses S7172-02 whose deadline is in the next sentence)

_classes.name: extends_existing wrong on widened limits / new clauses
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: whether braced text widens an existing authority vs. is wholly new needs the pre-amendment text

_classes.name: passive actor stored Unspecified (recurrence of Oct 17 fix)
_classes.rule: agency == 'Unspecified' and re.search(r'passive|not stated', actor_raw, re.I)

_classes.name: 'may so elect by filing' stored as a second power beside the authorization
_classes.rule: kind == 'power' and re.search(r'\bmay (so )?elect\b[^.]{0,40}\bby filing\b', quote, re.I) and another power of the same matter_id and agency_unit quotes 'authorized'

_classes.name: earlier-chapter sunset extension with unnamed holder left with no record after re-ask
_classes.rule: law-level: packet LAW TEXT matches r'(expire|deemed repealed)[^.]{0,80}\[[^\]]{1,40}\]\s*\{\{[^}]{1,40}\}\}' and no stored record of the matter_id quotes /expire|deemed repealed/ (upper bound: some laws carry the extension on the substantive sentence instead)
_classes.note: counts laws, not records; 473 of the 512 have zero stored records
